claims.head: Penalties could cost San Jose
claims.body: Edmonton’s power play creates 9.5 expected goals per 60, 1st in the league. San Jose’s penalty kill ranks 24th.

claims.body: Edmonton’s games average only 80.1 unblocked shots per 60 at 5-on-5, both teams combined (24th of 32 for pace); San Jose’s average 78.4 (29th).

claims.head: A physical night ahead
